intro.title: Watch one sentence become a mobile app.
intro.lede: Claude Code plans the work, splits it across helpers, fixes its own bugs and ships after you approve. Follow along on the phone.

outro.title: From prompt to pocket.
outro.lede: One sentence, one plan, three helpers, one bug squashed and one human approval.
outro.cta: Want to try this with your team? Ask SEA IT about the Claude Code pilot.

scenes.name: Plan
scenes.title: One sentence in. A plan out.
scenes.lede: You describe the app in plain words. Claude Code reads the project and proposes a step-by-step plan. Nothing is written until you approve it.
scenes.note: You can edit the plan before you approve it, or ask for a different approach.

script.text: Build a mobile app where staff raise IT service requests, track their status and get notified when something changes.
{dim:● Reading project…} empty folder, starting fresh
{acc:Plan} {dim:· plan mode, no files changed yet}

items: Scaffold an Expo app with 3 screens
Build a mock ticket service (ServiceNow-style API)
Add status badges and push notifications
Write a test for every request status
Commit, push and open a pull request

scenes.name: Subagents
scenes.title: Three helpers. One app.
scenes.lede: Claude splits the work. One helper builds the screens, one builds a mock ticket service and one writes tests. The phone fills in as they finish.
scenes.note: Each helper works in its own context. All their changes land in one diff that you review.

scenes.name: Self-heal
scenes.title: It finds its own bugs.
scenes.lede: Claude runs the test suite, reads the failure, fixes the cause and runs the tests again.
scenes.note: You still review the fix. Tests only catch what they cover.
scenes.hint: Tap the bug on the phone to squash it

items: {ok:✓} sends a notification on status change

script.text: {dim:● Reading src/status.ts…} pending_approval has no label

scenes.name: Ship
scenes.title: You approve. It ships.
scenes.lede: Pushing code needs your permission. After you approve, Claude commits, pushes, opens a pull request and CI checks the build.
scenes.note: Admins decide which actions always need a human to approve them.

script.text: {dim:● All tests pass. Ready to commit and push.}

script.deniedText: {warn:Denied.} Claude stops and waits. Nothing leaves your machine.

script.text: {pr:$} git commit -m "feat: IT service request app"
